title: Art
tagline: Painting and sculpture from the Parthenon to Pop Art
hero_caption: Michelangelo, The Creation of Adam (detail), Sistine Chapel, c. 1512
intro: Western art from ancient Greek sculpture to the 1980s, built around the artworks and the people who made them. Every artist has a full biography and every work a detailed introduction. Public-domain works are shown in high resolution from Wikimedia Commons; works still under copyright link to the official museum page.
